III. RECOMMENDED CORRECTIVE ACTIONS
1. File a §1362(f) inadvertent termination relief request to address the 2022 transfer to an ineligible shareholder.
2. Prepare and adopt a multi‑year distribution true‑up to restore pro rata compliance.
3. Reissue corrected K‑1s for all years lacking complete ownership data.
4. Reconstruct the stock ledger and consolidate all versions into a single authoritative record.
5. Produce (or confirm absence of) all shareholder loan documentation. If none exist, obtain written certifications.
6. Strengthen compliance and governance controls, including resolutions affirming S‑status compliance requirements.
